+    - Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/MCPServerCallTests.swift:403 waitForRecordedNotifications — waits for the notifications/cancelled that the bare-call timeout sends. A possible product gap: disconnect() does not drain this notice.
+    - Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/ResilienceTests.swift:617 gated.closeArrival.wait — waits for the close of the transport of the straggler after its discard. The close is the event under test. After the discard, no other event of the attempt comes.
+    - Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/ResilienceTests.swift:1018 waiting.value — the task of MCPServer.waitUntilReady(). It has no cancel handler. It ends only on ready or on a failed connect; a race needs a production change.
+    - Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/LostCallTests.swift:138 waitUntilTransportDropped — the call site of the product hook (group 1 line MCPServer+Call.swift:387). The drop is the event under test.
+    - Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/Support/MCPRelistWait.swift:27 waitUntilToolListChangedGeneration — the call site of the product hook in MCPTestSupport.waitForRelist(of:reaching:). It serves SurfaceRefresherTests (2 sites), LiveCatalogTests (2 sites) and RegistryRebuildTests (5 sites). The notifications are the event under test. After the hook, the re-list end and a require on catalogEpoch end each snapshot wait.
+    - Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/LiveCatalogTests.swift:237 waitUntilToolListChangedGeneration — the same product hook in emitBurstInOneWindow. The window must stay shut until the server counted the whole burst.
+    - Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/SurfaceRefresherTests.swift:289 waitForStages (12 call sites: 353, 359, 380, 383, 404, 407, 409, 411, 445, 503, 556, 581) — waits for a staged surface. SurfaceRefresher.apply() returns with no event for a snapshot that does not move the catalog, thus no event tells that no stage comes.
+    - Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/SurfaceRefresherTests.swift:301 waitForStage(holding:) (2 call sites: 475, 592) — the same event and the same reason.
+    - Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/DropObservingTransportTests.swift:96 endOf(mirrored) — waits for the end of the mirrored receive stream. The end is the event under test.
+    - Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/DropObservingTransportTests.swift:149 endOf(observed.receive()) — the same event and the same reason.
+    - Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/DropObservingTransportTests.swift:131 for try await in mirrored — the same event and the same reason.
+    - Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/DropObservingTransportTests.swift:135 for try await in later — the same event and the same reason.
+    - Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/LoopbackHTTPServerTests.swift:99 waitUntilServingEventStream — waits for the SSE GET of the client. The connect returns before the GET comes, and no other event of the server tells that it does not come.
+    - Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/LoopbackHTTPServerTests.swift:166 counter.firstObserved.wait — waits for an SSE notification. The POST reply has no order with the SSE stream, thus a ping is not a barrier here.
